rule.eligibility: Positive average match-margin improvement in both discovery panels; no fewer aggregate discovery wins than fixed.
rule.ranking: Equal-weight average of natural and controlled-panel margin improvements. Prefer the simpler candidate within 50 margin units of the best eligible score, in static, clock, visible order.
rule.promotion: On untouched confirmation seeds require positive average margin improvement, no fewer total wins than fixed, and more wins than losses in direct matches against fixed.
rule.reason: Freeze selection before inspecting discovery outcomes; do not retune models on these panels.

amendment.reason: Post-hoc attribution control prompted by discovery seed 124000 turn 517: planned MILK sale had no executed units, while STRAWBERRY traded. Earlier automatic liquidation can leave stale tape orders.
amendment.additional_control: available: move empty SELL orders behind available ones; preserve relative order within each group.
amendment.selection: Apply the original eligibility and equal-panel scoring rule to available, static, clock, visible, with that simplicity order and the original 50-unit tolerance.
amendment.confirmation: Use the original eight untouched seeds. If another policy is selected, include availability as a third confirmation policy. Require selection to improve mean confirmation margin over availability as well as passing original gates.
amendment.disclosure: The control was added after inspecting partial discovery logs; original four policy implementations and frozen manifests remain unchanged.
